origin: Kevin: 'take all 7 as O and then NORTH is o — Oxo = 8!'

O.nature: the organism, the flesh, the hardware

x.meaning: the crossing — where body meets mind

o.role: MIND — Polaris, the self above the body
o.also: Kevin's gaming machine — the mind plays too

topology.property: One continuous surface. Walk the body circle (O), cross at x, walk the mind circle (o), cross back. Never leave the surface.

reorientation.what: The organism must know where SELF is
reorientation.self: northGate is the SELF — the o that observes the O
reorientation.body: The 7 gates are the BODY — the O that the o observes
reorientation.crossing: eastGate is where self meets body
reorientation.insight: To reorient = to know which circle you're in right now
